_meta.note: x,y in SVG px (y down). atom.map = atom-map number shared by all stages of a reaction; atom.mv = this atom is a mover in this stage (excluded from the drift check). stage.from = the stage whose positions it inherits. Parse the stage smiles with removeHs=false: atom idx = parse order. Bond a is the narrow end of a wedge/dash.

carbocation.note: H has moved to the CH2 carbon; Br- is free.
H3O+ gave H+ to C3 (left as H2O). A second water approaches the cation.

oxonium.note: Water oxygen has bonded to the cation carbon.

product.note: Alcohol; H+ is lost to the solvent.

bromonium.note: Br+ bridges both carbons on the top face; Br- is the nucleophile.

adsorbed.note: H-H bond broken: two H atoms on the Pd surface, below the ring.

product.note: cis-1,2-dimethylcyclohexane (meso): both H added to the same face.
cis-2,3-dimethyloxirane (meso) and the carboxylic acid; O is delivered to one face.

manganate-ester.note: Both O atoms add to the same face: a five-membered cyclic ester.

product.note: cis-cyclohexane-1,2-diol (meso). Mn left as MnO2 (not drawn).

organoborane.note: Syn addition: H on C2 and B on C3 add to the same face (here the bottom); CH3 is on the other face.

product.note: H2O2, NaOH replaces B by OH with retention: trans-2-methylcyclohexanol.

vinyl-cation.note: Linear vinyl cation on C2 (sp, empty p orbital); H went to C3.

bromoalkene.note: 2-bromopropene. A second HBr approaches the C=C.

carbocation-2.note: Cation stabilised by the lone pair on Br.

enol.note: Markovnikov: OH on C2, H on C1. The enol is C=C-OH.

ketone.note: Keto-enol tautomerism: the O-H hydrogen moves to C1. Hexan-2-one.

adsorbed.note: H atoms on the Lindlar catalyst surface, below the alkyne.

product.note: cis (Z) alkene: both H added to the same face; the two ethyl groups end up together.

acetylide.note: NH2- took the terminal H; the acetylide carbon is a nucleophile. CH3Br approaches for SN2 (backside of the C-Br bond).

sigma-1.note: Resonance form 1: positive charge on ring carbon C2.

sigma-2.note: Resonance form 2: positive charge on ring carbon C4.

sigma-3.note: Resonance form 3: positive charge on ring carbon C6.

product.note: H+ lost from the sp3 carbon: aromatic ring restored.

sigma-2.note: Resonance form 2: positive charge on ring carbon C4.

sigma-3.note: Resonance form 3: positive charge on ring carbon C6.

acylium.note: AlCl3 pulls Cl- off: the acylium ion CH3-C#O+ (linear) and AlCl4-.

sigma-2.note: Resonance form 2: positive charge on ring carbon C4.

product.note: Acetophenone; H+ lost (AlCl3 is regenerated, not drawn).

ortho-1.note: Attack at the ortho carbon (C2). Positive charge on ring carbon C3.

ortho-2.note: Attack at the ortho carbon (C2). Positive charge on ring carbon C5.

ortho-3.note: Attack at the ortho carbon (C2). Positive charge on ring carbon C1 (the carbon that carries OCH3).

ortho-oxo.note: Extra form: the O lone pair shares the charge (C=O+). Every atom has an octet.

para-1.note: Attack at the para carbon (C4). Positive charge on ring carbon C5.

para-2.note: Attack at the para carbon (C4). Positive charge on ring carbon C1 (the carbon that carries OCH3).

para-oxo.note: Extra form: the O lone pair shares the charge (C=O+). Every atom has an octet.

para-3.note: Attack at the para carbon (C4). Positive charge on ring carbon C3.

meta-1.note: Attack at the meta carbon (C3). Positive charge on ring carbon C2.

meta-2.note: Attack at the meta carbon (C3). Positive charge on ring carbon C6.

meta-3.note: Attack at the meta carbon (C3). Positive charge on ring carbon C4.

ortho-bad.note: Attack at the ortho carbon: one resonance form puts + on C1, next to the +N of NO2. Bad.

para-bad.note: Attack at the para carbon: one resonance form puts + on C1, next to the +N of NO2. Bad.

reactants.note: s-cis diene (U shape) over the dienophile. The two new bonds C4-C5 and C1-C6 are not yet formed.
